best_addon.why: None passed: 0 of 26 popular strategies are positive with PF >= 1.3 in every span. Nearest misses (paper watch at most): Crabel stretch, 2022 ICT model (sweep + MSS + FVG).

rows.name: LIT (Zlarior)
rules: Sweep of a liquidity level (>= 0.5 ATR) after an inducement, then displacement and a 5m CISD back through it.
Limit at the CISD level (30 min), a 1m CISD confirms; entry at the next 1m open, 1 trade a day 02:00-15:30 ET.
Stop 1 tick beyond the sweep extreme, size follows the stop; one target: the VIX band, banked at 8R.

rows.name: ATLAS (EMA + MACD + S/R)
rules: Three lobes, each its own hours and 1 trade a day: EMA trend pullback, MACD divergence at a sweep, S/R sweep + reclaim.
Entry at the next 5m open after the trigger close; LIT goes first (no ATLAS entry while LIT is in a trade).
Stop beyond the setup's sweep wick; VIX-band target (S/R: 2R); breakeven + costs at 1R.

rows.name: Power of 3 / AMD
rules: accumulation = Asian range 20:00-00:00; manipulation = 00:00-09:30 takes exactly one side;
distribution = at the 09:30 open go the other way if price is on the far side of M (long: low swept and open above M; short mirror);
stop beyond the manipulation extreme (00:00-09:30 low / high).

rows.name: Judas Swing (London, midnight open)
rules: midnight open M (00:00 ET), Asian range 20:00-00:00. 02:00-05:00 ET: price takes the Asian high while above M, then a 5m close below M → short at next open;
stop beyond the high made since 00:00. Mirror long.

rows.name: London breakout (19:00-02:00 box)
rules: 02:00-05:00 OCO stop orders 1 tick beyond box high / low;
stop 1 tick beyond the opposite side of the box.

rows.name: Turtle Soup (20-day false breakout)
rules: Raschke/Connors: prior 20-session low made ≥ 4 sessions ago; today (09:30-15:00) trades below it;
buy stop at that prior 20-day low; stop 1 tick under today's low at entry.
Mirror for highs. Daily 20 bars, intraday exit.

rows.name: 2022 ICT model (sweep + MSS + FVG)
rules: windows 02:00-05:00 and 08:30-11:00 ET: a bar trades beyond the latest confirmed swing high (sweep); within 12 bars a close below the latest swing low before the sweep (MSS) with a bearish FVG formed from the sweep bar to the MSS bar;
limit at the FVG proximal edge, valid 12 bars after MSS; stop beyond the sweep extreme.
Mirror long.
rows.watch: Paper watch: the only ICT model that adds $ to LIT in both 2026 halves, but it loses 2021-25 and lifts H1 eval fails 1.6% -> 34% (popular-ict-2026-11-23).

rows.name: NY open FVG retrace (09:30-10:00)
rules: first FVG whose 3rd candle closes 09:30-10:00 ET;
limit at proximal edge until 11:00;
stop as 1.

rows.name: Silver Bullet (10-11 ET FVG)
rules: first FVG whose 3rd candle closes 10:00-11:00 ET; limit at proximal edge until 11:00;
stop beyond the 3-candle extreme (bull: min low of the 3; bear: max high).

rows.name: Unicorn (breaker + FVG)
rules: swings: low A, high B, lower low C (takes A), then a close above B (MSS). Breaker = the last up-close candle between B and C.
A bullish FVG in the C→MSS leg that overlaps the breaker range → limit at the top of the overlap, valid 12 bars after MSS; stop beyond C.
Mirror. Entries 02:00-15:00 ET.

rows.name: Previous-day high/low sweep and reversal
rules: previous session (18:00-17:00) high / low.
09:30-15:00 ET: first bar beyond either, then a 5m close back inside (within 12 bars) → market at next open;
stop beyond the sweep extreme.

rows.name: Asian range sweep and reversal
rules: Asian range 20:00-00:00.
00:00-11:00 ET: first bar to trade beyond either side, then a 5m close back inside the range (within 12 bars) → market at next open;
stop beyond the sweep extreme.

rows.name: Opening Range Breakout 30 min
rules: Opening range breakout, 30 min: OR = 09:30-10:00 high/low. First 5m close beyond it 10:00-12:00 → with it.
Stop = OR midpoint, target 2R, else 15:55. One a day.

rows.name: VWAP reversion (2 SD → VWAP)
rules: VWAP reversion: RTH VWAP from 09:30 (typical price x volume), volume-weighted SD bands.
A 5m close beyond +/-2 SD (10:00-15:00) → fade back to VWAP (target = VWAP at entry), stop 1 tick beyond the 3 SD band.
Max 2/day.

rows.name: VWAP trend pullback
rules: VWAP trend pullback: from 10:00-14:30, close above VWAP and VWAP rising (vs 6 bars ago) = up-trend; a bar whose low touches VWAP and closes back above it → long (mirror short).
Stop 1 tick beyond the bar, target 2R. Max 2/day.

rows.name: Connors RSI(2) 5m
rules: Connors RSI(2): close above SMA200 and RSI(2) below 10 → long; close below SMA200 and RSI(2) above 90 → short;
exit on a close back through SMA5 (long: close above SMA5). Disaster stop 2 x ATR(14).
Entries 09:45-15:00 RTH. 5m bars.

rows.name: Connors RSI(2) 15m
rules: Same on 15m bars (built from 5m, clock aligned);
exit / signal only on 15m closes.

rows.name: Donchian 20/10 breakout
rules: Donchian 20/10: close above the prior 20 bars' high → long, exit on a close below the prior 10 bars' low (mirror short);
initial stop = the 10-bar channel at entry.
5m bars (24h series), entries 10:00-15:00.

rows.name: NR7 inside-day breakout
rules: Crabel NR7 inside day: yesterday's RTH range is the narrowest of 7 AND inside the day before.
Today buy stop 1 tick above yesterday's high / sell stop below its low (first touched, 09:30-15:00), stop = yesterday's midpoint, out 15:55.

rows.name: Bollinger squeeze breakout
rules: Bollinger squeeze: BB(20, 2) inside Keltner(EMA20, 1.5 x ATR20) for ≥ 6 bars, then the first close outside BB → with it.
Stop = SMA20 (BB middle) at entry, target 2R.

rows.name: Opening gap fill
rules: Opening gap fill: gap = 09:30 open vs prior 15:55-bar close, 0.1% ≤ |gap| ≤ 0.5%.
Fade at the 09:30 open, target = prior close, stop = 1 x the gap beyond the open (1:1), out 15:55.

rows.name: Initial Balance breakout
rules: Initial Balance breakout: IB = 09:30-10:30. First 5m close beyond it 10:30-14:00 → with it.
Stop = IB midpoint, target = 1 IB width beyond the broken edge (1x extension). One a day.

rows.name: Initial Balance fade
rules: Initial Balance fade: price trades beyond the IB and a 5m close is back inside (within 3 bars), 10:30-14:00 → fade.
Stop 1 tick beyond the probe extreme, target = IB midpoint.
One a day.

rows.name: 9/21 EMA pullback in trend
rules: 9/21 EMA pullback: EMA9 above EMA21 and close above EMA21 = up-trend; a bar whose low touches EMA9 and closes above it → long (mirror).
Stop 1 tick below min(bar low, EMA21), target 2R. 09:45-15:00, max 3/day.

rows.name: Keltner channel breakout
rules: Keltner breakout: close above EMA20 + 2 x ATR10 → long (mirror); exit on a close back through EMA20;
initial stop = EMA20 at entry. 10:00-15:00.

rows.name: Crabel stretch
rules: Crabel stretch: stretch = 10-day mean of min(H-O, O-L) of RTH days.
Buy stop at open + stretch, sell stop at open - stretch (first hit), stop = the opposite level, out 15:55.
rows.watch: Paper lead only: the one classic strategy positive in all 3 spans, but Jul-Oct PF 1.07 and ES loses Jul-Oct (popular-classic-2026-11-23).

rows.name: End-of-day momentum (last 30 min)
rules: End-of-day momentum (Gao et al.): sign of the 09:30 → 15:25 return;
enter at the 15:30 open with it, out at the 15:55 open.
Disaster stop 2 x ATR(14) 5m.

rows.name: Turnaround Tuesday
rules: Turnaround Tuesday: Monday RTH close below Friday RTH close → long Tuesday 09:30 open → 15:55.
Disaster stop = 0.5 x ATR(14) of daily RTH ranges.
